comment: Budgets for crates/paged-gpu/tests/it/svg_reference.rs: each fixture SVG drawn by the engine (paged_gpu::svg, 1 px per user unit) against <name>.resvg.png, the same SVG drawn by resvg 0.48.1 as the engine's decoder called it before the CPU lane moved to vello_cpu (ADR 189). Both are composited over white; the numbers are the mean and 99th-percentile ΔE2000.
Measured 2026-10-19 (ADR 190). Each budget is the measurement plus 20 % (floors 0.05 / 0.5). Never loosen one to make a run pass: fix the renderer, then tighten.

Where resvg misreads the specification the rationale says so, with what Chrome 155 (headless, 1x) and librsvg 2.62 draw, measured the same way: displacement, lighting-color, morphology, tile and transformed.
measured.before is main before ADR 190 (filters dropped), against the same reference.

fixtures.name: blend
fixtures.rationale: feBlend in every separable and non-separable mode onto a flood, and onto an offset copy of itself. The modes match resvg to a level; what remains is the rasterizers' antialiasing on the discs' edges.

fixtures.name: blur
fixtures.rationale: feGaussianBlur at σ 1.2 (the exact kernel), 6 and 10 × 2 (five boxes across, the exact kernel down), in sRGB, on a group at 60 % opacity.

fixtures.name: clip-mask
fixtures.rationale: Clip paths (even-odd, objectBoundingBox units, a clip path clipped by another), a luminance mask with a gradient, an alpha mask on a group at 80 %, a pattern. No filters: before this change it measured 0.269 / 4.53, the pattern tile filtered bicubically where tiny-skia copies a tile that lands on whole pixels.

fixtures.name: color-matrix
fixtures.rationale: feColorMatrix: a matrix (sepia), saturate, hueRotate, luminanceToAlpha.

fixtures.name: component-transfer
fixtures.rationale: feComponentTransfer: table, discrete, linear and gamma functions, and a table on alpha.

fixtures.name: composite
fixtures.rationale: feComposite: over, in, out, atop, xor and arithmetic, over a moved, recoloured copy of the source.

fixtures.name: convolve
fixtures.rationale: feConvolveMatrix: emboss, edge detection with preserveAlpha and bias, sharpen with edgeMode duplicate. The kernels multiply the rasterizers' antialiasing differences on the circle's edge, hence the p99.

fixtures.name: displacement
fixtures.rationale: feDisplacementMap driven by noise and by the art's own red channel. resvg multiplies the displacement by the scale twice (scale² · ½), so its art scatters off the canvas; the engine displaces by scale · (C − ½) as the specification and browsers do. Against a browser (Chrome 155 headless) the engine measures 0.683/31.75 and resvg 12.151/57.33; librsvg 0.872/34.46. The budget guards the engine's own result against resvg's.

fixtures.name: drop-shadow
fixtures.rationale: The drop shadow editors write (feGaussianBlur of SourceAlpha → feOffset → feFlood → feComposite in → feMerge), feDropShadow, and a glow (feMorphology dilate → blur → flood → composite → merge).

fixtures.name: gradients
fixtures.rationale: Linear and radial gradients: stop opacity, reflect and repeat, a gradientTransform, a focal point and focal radius, a gradient on a stroke. No filters: before this change it measured 0.950 / 15.23, because vello_cpu interpolates stops premultiplied and SVG (resvg, browsers) does not; SVG gradients now interpolate straight.

fixtures.name: lighting
fixtures.rationale: feSpecularLighting under a distant light over a blurred alpha (a bevel), feDiffuseLighting under a point light, feSpecularLighting under a spot light with a cone. White light only; coloured light is lighting-color.

fixtures.name: lighting-color
fixtures.rationale: A coloured light. lighting-color is an sRGB colour, which the engine takes into the filter's linearRGB space, as Chrome does; resvg and librsvg use it as if it were already linear, so their light comes out paler. Against Chrome the engine measures 0.081/0.87, resvg 4.581/12.60, librsvg 4.581/12.60.

fixtures.name: merge
fixtures.rationale: feMerge of three moved and recoloured copies and the source.

fixtures.name: morphology
fixtures.rationale: feMorphology erode and dilate, fractional and per-axis radii, and an outline built on dilate. The engine's window is 2r + 1 pixels wide, as browsers and librsvg have it; resvg reads the specification's text (2r) and its window is a pixel narrower and off-centre. Against Chrome the engine measures 0.225/5.71, resvg 1.662/42.46, librsvg 0.188/3.79.

fixtures.name: text
fixtures.rationale: SVG text, which neither this build nor the resvg one before it draws: usvg is built without fonts (ADR 189), so only the rectangles and the shadow under the last one draw, in both. A known gap.

fixtures.name: tile
fixtures.rationale: feTile of a swatch built from a flood and the art, and of a flood in sRGB. resvg marks a tile's result sRGB whatever space its input was in, so a linearRGB tile comes out dark; the engine keeps the input's space. Against Chrome the engine measures 0.040/1.90, resvg 3.916/25.81, librsvg 0.071/2.19.

fixtures.name: transformed
fixtures.rationale: Filters under a viewBox at half size (every length doubles), userSpaceOnUse and objectBoundingBox units, primitive subregions, a rotated and a skewed group. resvg (and librsvg) filter in device space, so a rotated group's flood stays upright; the engine filters in the group's own axes and draws the result back through the rotation, as Chrome does. Against Chrome the engine measures 0.347/3.02, resvg 1.177/29.05, librsvg 1.268/29.05.

fixtures.name: turbulence
fixtures.rationale: feTurbulence (turbulence and fractalNoise, one to four octaves, a negative seed), a paper grain (noise, desaturated, arithmetic composite, clipped to the shape) and marbling (noise as the alpha of a colour). The noise is the specification's reference generator; resvg's and librsvg's agree with it to a level (Chrome samples it at pixel centres).
